resources.string: Scroll Counter counts the Reels, Shorts and short videos you watch — in any social or video app (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and others) and on short-video websites in your browser. To recognise a reels feed it looks only at the layout of the screen (the size of the video player, its view names and how it scrolls). It does not read or store text, web addresses, messages, captions, comments or anything you type, and all data stays on your device. It also shows a small counter at the top while you watch, and takes you to the home screen once your daily limit is reached.
